title: Add Analytical Chart Overlays (VisualElements)

scenarios.title: Add Analytical Chart Overlays applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Add Analytical Chart Overlays (BtnChartOverlay) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Chart Overlay stacked-total math and analytical formulas are pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: ChartOverlay uses the production ChartOverlayMathPolicy: every native chart series is summed per point regardless of chart grouping; Delta is end-start; Growth is (end-start)/abs(start)*100; CAGR uses point-index distance as the period count and preserves the historical non-positive-start NaN/Infinity behavior; Average uses the arithmetic mean; outliers use population standard deviation and the historical 1.2σ threshold.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
